source_question: Thanks so much, amigo! Really appreciate it. 对方说 now you have a lot to read。看下怎么回复，再加一下，等我整理下思路，我可能需要你帮我检查一下。
core: Let me organize my thoughts first, and I may need your help to review everything later.
meaning_cn: 让我先整理一下思路，之后可能还需要你帮我一起检查一下。
explanation_cn: organize my thoughts 是自然的“整理思路”表达；may need your help to ... 用于礼貌地提前说明后续可能需要对方协助。review everything later 比 check it later 更适合材料、思路或方案尚未完全确定的场景。
source_sentence: 等我整理下思路，我可能需要你帮我检查一下。

examples.en: Let me organize my thoughts first, and I may need your help to review everything later.
examples.cn: 让我先整理一下思路，之后可能还需要你帮我一起检查一下。

examples.en: Let me organize my thoughts first, then I'll send you a clearer version.
examples.cn: 让我先整理一下思路，然后我会发你一个更清晰的版本。

examples.en: I may need your help to review the deck once I have the structure ready.
examples.cn: 等我把结构整理好后，可能需要你帮我一起检查这份材料。

pronunciation.text: Let me organize my thoughts first, and I may need your help to review everything later.
pronunciation.hint_cn: 重读 organize my thoughts、need your help、review 和 later；Let me 和 I may need 可自然连读，整体语气保持轻松、礼貌。

source_question: 未来得事情还不知道，一切皆有可能
core: We don't know what will happen in the future. Anything is possible.
meaning_cn: 未来会发生什么还不知道，一切皆有可能。
explanation_cn: We don't know what will happen in the future 是直接、自然的“未来会怎样还不知道”；Anything is possible 是常用表达“一切皆有可能”。两句分开说比用复杂从句更清楚，也适合日常聊天。
source_sentence: 未来得事情还不知道，一切皆有可能

examples.en: We don't know what will happen in the future. Anything is possible.
examples.cn: 未来会发生什么还不知道，一切皆有可能。

examples.en: Things may change later. Anything is possible.
examples.cn: 以后情况可能会变，一切皆有可能。

examples.en: I haven't made a final decision yet. Anything is possible.
examples.cn: 我还没有做最终决定，一切皆有可能。

pronunciation.text: We don't know what will happen in the future. Anything is possible.
pronunciation.hint_cn: 重读 know、happen、future、anything 和 possible；第一句语气平稳，第二句稍加强调。

source_question: 太感谢了怎么说；Thanks so much, amigo! Really appreciate it.
core: Thanks so much. I really appreciate it.
meaning_cn: 太感谢了，我真的很感激。
explanation_cn: Thanks so much 是自然、常用的加强感谢；I really appreciate it 比单独说 Really appreciate it 更完整，也适合工作聊天。对熟悉的同事可以保留轻松语气，但在更正式场景中用完整主语 I 会更稳妥。
source_sentence: Thanks so much, amigo! Really appreciate it.

examples.en: Thanks so much. I really appreciate it.
examples.cn: 太感谢了，我真的很感激。

examples.en: Thanks so much for your help. I really appreciate it.
examples.cn: 非常感谢你的帮助，我真的很感激。

examples.en: I really appreciate you taking the time to review the deck.
examples.cn: 非常感谢你抽时间帮我检查这份材料。

pronunciation.text: Thanks so much. I really appreciate it.
pronunciation.hint_cn: 重读 thanks、much、really 和 appreciate；appreciate 重音在第二音节附近，整句保持自然、真诚的感谢语气。

source_question: Accelerate FTTH Deployment to Against ISP Competition 改下，加上在存量HFC区域加速叠光建网，应对未来的ISP竞争
core: Accelerate FTTH deployment in existing HFC areas to counter future ISP competition.
meaning_cn: 在存量 HFC 区域加速 FTTH 叠加建设，以应对未来的 ISP 竞争。
explanation_cn: to against 不成立，因为不定式 to 后面需要接动词原形，而 against 是介词。这里用 to counter ... 表示“应对/抵御……竞争”最自然。in existing HFC areas 明确动作范围，future ISP competition 表示未来可能加剧的 ISP 竞争。
source_sentence: Accelerate FTTH Deployment to Against ISP Competition

examples.en: Accelerate FTTH deployment in existing HFC areas to counter future ISP competition.
examples.cn: 在存量 HFC 区域加速 FTTH 叠加建设，以应对未来的 ISP 竞争。

examples.en: We need to accelerate fiber overlay in priority HFC areas to counter competitive pressure.
examples.cn: 我们需要在重点 HFC 区域加速叠光，以应对竞争压力。

examples.en: Accelerate network upgrades to prepare for stronger competition next year.
examples.cn: 加快网络升级，为明年更激烈的竞争做好准备。

pronunciation.text: Accelerate FTTH deployment in existing HFC areas to counter future ISP competition.
pronunciation.hint_cn: 重读 accelerate、FTTH deployment、existing HFC areas、counter、competition；to counter 可轻连读，突出动作与目的。

source_question: CWP体验有优势，但差距有限
core: CWP has an experience advantage, but the gap is limited.
meaning_cn: CWP 在用户体验上有一定优势，但差距有限。
explanation_cn: has an experience advantage 表示“在体验上占优”；but the gap is limited 用来补充说明这种优势并不大。这个结构适合 PPT 中表达“有优势，但领先幅度有限”，比只说 better experience 更准确。
source_sentence: CWP体验有优势，但差距有限

examples.en: CWP has an experience advantage, but the gap is limited.
examples.cn: CWP 在用户体验上有一定优势，但差距有限。

examples.en: Claro has a speed advantage, but the gap is limited.
examples.cn: Claro 在速率上有优势，但差距有限。

examples.en: The new plan performs better, but the gap is still limited.
examples.cn: 新套餐表现更好，但差距仍然有限。

pronunciation.text: CWP has an experience advantage, but the gap is limited.
pronunciation.hint_cn: 重读 experience advantage、gap 和 limited；but 前后可轻停顿，突出“有优势，但差距有限”的转折。
